sourceSentences: Innate: After casting an ability, Lucian's next basic attack within 3.5 seconds fires an additional shot on-attack after 0.25 seconds.

Innate - Vigilance: Whenever Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or an enemy champion within 1000 units is immobilized, his next two shots within 6 seconds are empowered to deal bonus magic damage on-hit. He can store up to 4 empowered shots at a time.
Lucian can buffer W or R during the cast time. E is locked out.
Piercing Light's cast time ends prematurely if the initial target dies, allowing Lucian to attack and move freely, or to immediately begin casting either W or R.
Ardent Blaze will cast from wherever Lucian is at the end of the cast time.
Lucian gains bonus movement speed for 1 second when he or allied champions damage a marked target. Allied champions triggering this effect grant Lucian Lightslinger.
Passive: Relentless Pursuit's current cooldown is reduced by 1 second for each Lightslinger shot hit, doubled to 2 seconds against enemy champions.
Relentless Pursuit resets Lucian's basic attack timer. Lucian can cast any of his abilities during the dash. Relentless Pursuit can be cast during W cast time and during R channel.
Relentless Pursuit's dash can go through terrain, but will not be extended further if the target location is within terrain.
Casting Relentless Pursuit directly after attacking with Lightslinger will reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown when the projectiles hit the target.
The Culling can be recast after 0.75 seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends.
For level one, the best combo to do, especially when cheesing an enemy or walking up for a short quick trade in lane, is auto attack, Q, and auto attack.

For the most DPS, you want to keep your ult for after you've used all your basic abilities whilst they are on cooldown. And as soon as they start coming back up, you cancel your ult and go back to cycling your basic abilities again.
One of the few exceptions where you want to use two abilities together is the super important E plus W combo. You can basically cast your W while you're dashing.
